items.title: Nvidia Stock Shock Has Investors Rethinking AI Infrastructure ETFs
items.summary: Governance risk at Nvidia has suddenly moved from fine print to front page, and that shift matters for every investor leaning on big tech ETFs for stability. When a single leadership probe can ripple through AI supply chains and export rules, concentration risk stops being theoretical. This piece walks through three mega cap stocks exposed to the same news shock, and shows how governance resilience might help you decide where to lean in or step back. items.title: OpenAI's Hail Mary: GPT-6.2 Astra and a $1.25 trillion bet
items.summary: OpenAI has gone quiet while Anthropic takes the IPO spotlight, but it hasn't been idle. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down what it's been doing, from ChatGPT handling a fifth of Google's searches and poaching Anthropic talent to a shrinking funding round, a compute crunch and the GPT-6.2 Astra model waiting in the wings.
